## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change class

Select all that apply:

- [ ] Documentation / presentation only
- [ ] Software / reproducibility
- [ ] Data / provenance
- [ ] Accounting / dimensional structure
- [ ] Reference mode / measurement
- [ ] Behavioural mechanism
- [ ] System Dynamics structure
- [ ] Release / versioning

## Scientific effect

- [ ] No canonical scientific-state change
- [ ] Canonical scientific-state change proposed

If state changes, identify the governing registry/contract and explain the evidence that authorizes the change.

## Evidence / source boundary

List the official or reproducible evidence used. State any important limitations, missingness or provider-access uncertainty.

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] Missing/TBD values were not converted to zero.
- [ ] No bilateral allocation was invented to close a matrix.
- [ ] Provider/access failure was not treated as negative scientific evidence.
- [ ] No reserved holdout/prospective outcome was inspected outside its contract.
- [ ] Candidate behavioural/SD structure was not treated as quantitatively active without an activation gate.
- [ ] Relevant canonical registries/tests were updated together if scientific state changed.
- [ ] Version metadata was not changed unless this is an authorized release change.

## Verification

List the tests/audits run and their result.

## Release impact

- [ ] No version bump required.
- [ ] Release preparation required under the atomic release-versioning contract.
